calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl, sum(f.quantity) AS qty_all,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qty_test, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qty_staff,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_lines, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date),
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS ctrl_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory<>cp.subcategory OR p.category<>cp.category THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_restated
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY units DESC, cp.subcategory LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8
